summary: Build practical procurement data, spend analysis, and dashboard skills. Explore the five-day purchasing analytics course and review the outline.
lede: Procurement and big data analytics use purchasing records from varied sources to identify spend patterns, supplier performance issues, and sourcing opportunities. For procurement analysts, category managers, and sourcing professionals, this foundation-level course builds skills in preparing and classifying data, applying Pareto and ABC analysis, creating supplier scorecards and dashboard outlines, and reporting findings for sourcing and supplier reviews with clear assumptions and limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with purchasing transactions, supplier data, sourcing decisions, or procurement reporting. It suits foundation-level learners who want a practical route from procurement records to usable analysis.
outcomes: Dashboard Design In Power BI Tableau
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: familiarity with basic procurement activity, such as purchase orders, suppliers, or category records. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to spreadsheet software; Power BI may be used where available. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted classification are introduced at awareness level.
